public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI does not grasp the big picture as human radiologists do; it is better at vision than at understanding case files.

statement.excerpt: I don’t really think machines get the big picture that human radiologists do; they are better on vision than understanding the case files and notes and so on.
statement.document_title: What was 60 Minutes thinking, in that interview with Geoff Hinton?

from_speaker: the big picture that human radiologists do
better on vision than understanding the case files and notes
our_interpretation: I assess the functional comparison, not whether machines possess subjective understanding.
Big picture means integrating imaging findings with patient history and clinical notes to reach an appropriate diagnosis.
Better on vision means stronger relative performance on image interpretation than on clinical-context integration.
For this ongoing capability claim, I use the latest pre-post reporting window, 2023 through 2023-10-10. This field has no standard quarterly reporting period.
criteria.support_condition: Matched evaluations of contemporary systems show stronger performance on image interpretation than clinical-context integration, with radiologists superior on integrated cases.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matched evaluations show that contemporary AI matches or exceeds radiologists on integrated cases and does not exhibit the claimed relative weakness in clinical-context interpretation.
